extracted.intended_audience: Investigators preparing an NIH PHS 398 research grant application (e.g., R01/resubmission)
extracted.subtask_description: Assemble and complete required PHS 398 application components (forms, modular budgets, vertebrate/human sections) and write the Research Plan (Specific Aims, Significance, Innovation, Approach) with personnel and budget justifications, compliance statements, and contingency plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate animals euthanasia compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: If vertebrate animals are euthanized, indicate method and whether it is consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'No' to AVMA guidelines, describe the euthanasia method and provide a scientific justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program income reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether program income is anticipated during the requested grant support periods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If yes, provide for each budget period: anticipated amount ($) and source(s) using the provided format; otherwise leave blank.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human embryonic stem cell (hESC) disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether the proposed project involves human embryonic stem cells.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If yes, list registration number(s) from the NIH registry (http://grants.nih.gov/stem_cells/registry/current.htm) or check that a registry line will be used if a specific line cannot be referenced at submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human fetal tissue (HFT) compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the project involves human fetal tissue obtained from elective abortions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If yes, provide the HFT Compliance Assurance and the HFT Sample IRB Consent Form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions and patents reporting (renewal applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose whether there are inventions and patents related to the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'Yes', indicate whether they have been previously reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of PD/PI or institution reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: When changing Project Director/Principal Investigator or grantee institution, provide identifying details of the former PD/PI and former institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include prefix, full name (first, middle, last), suffix, and name of former institution as requested on the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modular budget and F&A (indirect) reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: For each budget period provide direct costs (less consortium indirect), consortium indirect (F&A), total direct costs, and indirect (F&A) cost details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report Indirect (F&A) Type, Indirect (F&A) Rate (%), Indirect (F&A) Base ($), Funds Requested ($), MTDC or other bases, Cognizant Agency name and contact, Indirect (F&A) Rate Agreement Date, and totals for direct and indirect costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cumulative budget information and justifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide totals for the entire project period and supporting budget justifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include Section A totals (Direct less Consortium Indirect; Consortium Indirect; Total Direct), Section B totals (Total Indirect F&A), Section C totals (Total Direct and Indirect), and attach Personnel Justification, Consortium Justification, and Additional Narrative Justification documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel justification content
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe each key person's role, effort (months or percent effort), responsibilities, and relevant qualifications or prior contributions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each named individual include position/title, specific duties on the project, calendar/months of effort, prior relevant experience and demonstrated contributions (e.g., preliminary data, techniques performed), and how effort contributes to project aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required Research Plan sections
rubrics_metrics.description: The Research Plan must include specified components and other research plan items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include (as applicable) Introduction (for resubmission/revision), Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Progress Report Publication List, Vertebrate Animals, Select Agent Research, Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan, Consortium/Contractual Arrangements, Letters of Support, Resource Sharing Plan(s), Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources, and Appendix.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims clarity and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a concise Specific Aims page outlining the overall objectives and the individual aims (e.g., Aim 1, Aim 2, Aim 3) and their rationale.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize the problem significance, central hypothesis/questions, and a short description of what each aim will accomplish and why (brief summary/overview).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy: Significance
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain why the research problem is important and how the project will advance scientific knowledge, public health, or clinical practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the scope of the problem (e.g., disease burden), biological rationale (e.g., relevance of RLRs), link to Notices of Special Interest if relevant, and potential impact on human health or understanding of mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy: Innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain how the project challenges current paradigms or employs novel concepts, approaches, or models.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe innovations such as novel model systems (e.g., whole-animal C. elegans), new methods (e.g., adapting single-cell RNAseq), or unique tools that provide advantages over current approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy: Approach (including preliminary data and methods)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide detailed experimental approach for each aim including background/preliminary data, specific methods, planned analyses, expected outcomes, and timelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include experimental design (e.g., CRISPR tagging, tissue-specific rescue/depletion, scRNAseq), validation steps (confirm tagged protein function by infection and qRT-PCR), reagents/strains, instrumentation, replicates and sample sizes, statistical tests, and specific decision points.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approach: potential outcomes, pitfalls, and alternative strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: For each aim describe likely outcomes, potential problems, and fallback/alternative methods to achieve the aim if primary approaches fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide concrete backups (e.g., use split wrmScarlet, multiple-copy transgenes, transcriptional reporter, alternative degron systems like AID2, tissue-specific RNAi) and justification for preferred vs backup options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Experimental validation and controls
rubrics_metrics.description: Design experiments with appropriate validation steps and controls to confirm that manipulations (tags, transgenes, degradations) do not impair function and that observed phenotypes reflect intended perturbations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: test that tagged DRH-1 rescues drh-1 mutant defects using viral infection and qRT-PCR viral load/IPR expression; confirm tissue-specificity via fluorescent tags; use organelle markers and dyes for colocalization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical reporting and replication
rubrics_metrics.description: Report number of independent experiments, sample sizes per experiment, statistical tests used, and significance thresholds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example presented: means compared using One-way ANOVA with Bonferroni correction, report number of independent experiments, indicate NS or p-values (e.g., ****p<0.0001), and provide description of how samples were pooled or counted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource sharing and authentication
rubrics_metrics.description: Include plans for resource sharing and authentication of key biological and/or chemical resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide Resource Sharing Plan(s) and a separate Authentication_of_Key_Bio_Resources document detailing how materials and reagents will be validated and shared.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix and supporting materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Include an Appendix with allowable supporting documents, figures, or data referenced in the Research Plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach supporting files such as Specific_Aims.pdf, Research_Strategy.pdf, Personnel_Justification_Final.pdf, Letters_of_Support.pdf, and any other permitted appendix material.
